title: Interstellar
overview: A team of explorers travel through a wormhole in space in an attempt to ensure humanity's survival as Earth faces catastrophic famine.

title: Inception
overview: A thief who steals corporate secrets through dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a CEO.

title: The Dark Knight
overview: When the menace known as the Joker wreaks havoc and chaos on the people of Gotham Batman must accept one of the greatest psychological and physical tests of his ability to fight injustice.

title: Pulp Fiction
overview: The lives of two mob hitmen a boxer a gangster and his wife and a pair of diner bandits intertwine in four tales of violence and redemption.

title: Django Unchained
overview: With the help of a German bounty hunter a freed slave sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal Mississippi plantation owner.

title: Spirited Away
overview: During her family's move to the suburbs a sullen 10-year-old girl wanders into a magical world ruled by gods witches and spirits where humans are changed into beasts.

title: Princess Mononoke
overview: On a journey to find the cure for a Tatarigami's curse Ashitaka finds himself in the middle of a war between the forest gods and Tatara a mining colony.

title: Superbad
overview: Two co-dependent high school seniors are forced to deal with separation anxiety after their plan to stage a booze-soaked party goes awry.

title: The Hangover
overview: Three buddies wake up from a bachelor party in Las Vegas with no memory of the previous night and the bachelor missing.

title: La La Land
overview: While navigating their careers in Los Angeles a pianist and an actress fall in love while attempting to reconcile their aspirations for the future.

title: Whiplash
overview: A promising young drummer enrolls at a cut-throat music conservatory where his dreams of greatness are mentored by an instructor who will stop at nothing to realize a student's potential.

title: A Quiet Place
overview: In a post-apocalyptic world a family is forced to live in silence while hiding from monsters with ultra-sensitive hearing.

title: Get Out
overview: A young African-American visits his white girlfriend's parents for the weekend where his simmering uneasiness about their reception of him eventually reaches a boiling point.

title: The Matrix
overview: When a beautiful stranger leads computer hacker Neo to a forbidding underworld he discovers the shocking truth the life he knows is the elaborate deception of an evil cyber-intelligence.

title: Parasite
overview: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan.

title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
overview: A writer encounters the owner of an aging high-class hotel who tells him of his early years serving as a lobby boy in the hotel's glorious years under an exceptional concierge.

title: Moonrise Kingdom
overview: Two 12-year-olds who fall in love make a secret pact and run away together into the wilderness.

title: Toy Story
overview: A cowboy doll is profoundly threatened and jealous when a new spaceman action figure supplants him as top toy in a boy's room.

title: Finding Nemo
overview: After his son is captured in the Great Barrier Reef and taken to Sydney a timid clownfish sets out on a journey to bring him home.

title: The Social Network
overview: As Harvard student Mark Zuckerberg creates the social networking site that would become known as Facebook he is sued by the twins who claimed he stole their idea.
